heard: Jean de Valette fired the heads of prisoners from his cannons. In 1565 between 23 and 48 thousand Ottoman invaders arrived to conquer Malta. To prepare the Grand Master poisoned his own wells. After Fort Saint Elmo fell, Ottomans floated decapitated knights across the harbor. Valette retaliated by firing his prisoners' heads back. The garrison held until relief arrived in September. But the brutal siege began when the enemy armada arrived.
